comments.content: `renderCommands(runContext, taskCommands)` is now invoked here for the debug log and again in `configure()` via `withCmd(this.renderCommands(...))`. Since `renderCommands` performs internal-storage replacement and full re-rendering (including re-assembling interpreter+beforeCommands+commands), this duplicates non-trivial work and, worse, may produce different values between the log line and the actual container command if rendering is non-deterministic (e.g. new temp file paths for internal storage). Render once and reuse the result for both the debug log and `configure()`.

`start()` assembles `finalCommands` from interpreter+beforeCommands+commands via `scriptCommands()` and stores the merged list into `this.commands` (a `Property<List<String>>`). But `TaskRunner.renderCommands()` (called by Process/Docker runners) re-reads `taskCommands.getInterpreter()`, `getBeforeCommands()` and `getCommands()` separately and concatenates them again. After this point interpreter/beforeCommands still hold their original values while `commands` holds the full merged command, so the runner will prepend interpreter+beforeCommands a second time, duplicating the interpreter/before-commands. Please confirm the runner's `renderCommands` path is not exercised for the wrapper flow, or clear interpreter/beforeCommands after merging.
